newsitem.title: BELARUS: Lukashenko draft constitution wins in Belarus.
newsitem.headline: Lukashenko draft constitution wins in Belarus.

text.p: President Alexander Lukashenko's draft constitution was approved by 70.5 percent of those who voted in Sunday's referendum in Belarus, according to preliminary results from the central electoral commission.

"In question number two, 70.5 percent voted for," an official told Reuters by telephone. Lukashenko's constitutional draft, number two on the ballot paper, will give him the right to significantly widen his powers.
Lukashenko has said the referendum result will be binding and will now go into force, giving him an extra two years in office and authority to remodel parliament into two chambers.
The opposition has accused him of violating the existing constitution and parliamentary deputies last week launched an attempt to impeach him.
Polling ended on Sunday among the more than seven million voters. Turnout was more than 84 percent.
Lukashenko has been in power since 1994.
